reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "⚠️ Potentially BREAKING: Log messages that were not structured have now been replaced with structured logs", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Log message format changes; setups matching on specific log strings could break.
consequence.remediation: Update any log matching rules to the new structured log format.

proposed.statement: Previously unstructured cert-manager log messages are now structured logs, which may break setups that match on specific log strings.
